title: About
subtitle: Learn about Harbour Masters and LibUltraShip

whatIsHM.title: What is Harbour Masters?
whatIsHM.content: Harbour Masters is a team of passionate developers dedicated to preserving and enhancing classic Nintendo 64 and GameCube games through native PC ports. We build upon decompilation projects once they reach completion, recreating the original game code in modern C++ and enhancing it with new features.

whatIsLUS.title: What is LibUltraShip (LUS)?
whatIsLUS.content: LibUltraShip (LUS) is our modern recreation of the Nintendo 64 SDK, known as LibUltra. It provides the foundation for all our ports, handling graphics, audio, input, and core game systems. LUS now supports both Nintendo 64 and GameCube-era games, bringing them to modern platforms with enhanced features and cross-platform support.
features: Flexible input handling for any controller

ourPorts.title: Our Ports
ourPorts.intro: Each port maintains the authentic experience while adding modern enhancements:
enhancements: Improved frame rates and reduced input latency

team.title: The Team
team.content: Harbour Masters is made possible by contributions from developers, reverse engineers, and community members around the world. Join our Discord to connect with the community!

legal.title: Legal Information
legal.content: Our ports are created through clean-room reverse engineering. We do not distribute any copyrighted assets including ROM files. Users must provide their own legally-obtained ROM files. Nintendo 64 is a trademark of Nintendo Co., Ltd. Our projects are not affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo.
